metadata.reproducibility: Single run per case per round with a sampling model; results may vary on rerun. Evidence line references (transcript.md:N, jsonl #N) point to raw transcripts that were not retained, so they cannot be re-checked. Assertion texts and evidence were translated from the original Chinese grading notes; quoted model output is paraphrased in English and may differ slightly in wording.
